newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:
Spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said Commissioner Padraig Flynn welcomed the social partners draft framework agreement on part-time work concluded on Wednesday.

Asked if the United Kingdom was bound by this agreement she said no member state was yet bound by the agreement since it was still at draft stage. The British organisations TUC and CBI were nevertheless involved in the discussions that lead to the protocol through their membership to the European organisations UNICE and ETUC, Nolan said.
UNICE, ETUC and CEEP, trade union and employer organisations at European level still have to ratify the protocol, she said.
Spokesman Jochen Kubosch briefed on the Court of Justice judgments.
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard would hold a news conference on Tuesday on swimming waters.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/409: Prospects and potential obstacles to progress of European capital markets for SMEs.
- IP/97/410: Ex-Yugoslavia: European Commission approves humanitarian aid package worth ECU 98 million.
- IP/97/411: Commission creates 57 new Jean Monnet chairs in European Universities.
- IP/97/414: Commission authorises the acquisition of joint control of both the RTE companies and SSM Coal B.V. by SHV Deelmingen Maatshappij B.V. and Reheinbraun Brennstoff GmbH.
- IP/97/416: Padraig Flynn welcomes the social partners framework agreement on part-time work.
- Speech/97/109: Speech by Commissioner Monika Wulf-Mathies at EU Committee of the Regions first summit of the regions and cities.
- Speech/97/111: Speech by Commissioner Emma Bonino at Round Table on practical aspects of the changeover to the Euro.
- Speech/97/112: Summary of speech by Commissioner Anita Gradin on "New trends in drug misuse".
- Agenda of the Round Table on practical aspects of the changeover to the Euro.
- Working paper for the Round Table on practical aspects of the changeover to the Euro.
